description:
A worker started with ``--evaluate``: score solutions with a model, without searching.

The answer is one JSON line, ``{"objectives": [...]}`` in the order of ``solutions`` on the
scale ``best_objective`` reports, or ``{"error": ...}`` when the model cannot build or a
solution cannot be decoded. A Rust worker is the model, so it reads only ``instance`` and
``solutions``.

heuristic.description: A heuristic of the model's solve.json. The Python worker starts a run of it from each solution and stops it before its first iteration, so a built-in problem scores the solution as a run would report it.
heuristic.title: Heuristic

model_path.description: Path of the model.py that scores the solutions.
model_path.title: Model Path

solutions.description: Solutions in the form encode_solution writes.
solutions.title: Solutions

title: EvaluateRequest
